Insight: 1. Revenue realisation declines after discounts and returns
Evidence: Gross revenue ₹8,456,050 fell to ₹8,021,851.20 after discounts and ₹7,200,464.20 realised after returns. The gross-to-realised gap is ₹1,255,585.80 (about 14.85%).
Recommended_Action: Review discount depth and return reasons by product, category, city, and channel; monitor gross-to-net realisation.

Insight: 2. Returns are a material leakage signal
Recommended_Action: Analyse return reasons and patterns; investigate product quality, descriptions, delivery, and customer expectations.

Insight: 3. High-Value customers contribute the largest share
Evidence: 62 customers (31%) account for 43.53% of realised revenue, approximately ₹3.13M based on the rounded share.
Recommended_Action: Prioritise loyalty, personalised recommendations, and retention; monitor repeat purchase and realised revenue.

Insight: 5. Predictive performance improved but CLV targets remain unmet
Evidence: Six-month revenue baseline MAE ₹8,934.36, RMSE ₹10,831.92; MAE improved ~61.3% versus initial naïve baseline. Silhouette score 0.4175. This is not full lifetime-value prediction.
Recommended_Action: Treat as directional. Add gross margin, acquisition cost, discount rate, and lifetime assumptions. Do not claim silhouette ≥0.85 or MAE <₹500 was achieved.
